description: Hazala wears a floor-length cream-gold dress with a low square neckline and fitted opaque bodice. Dark brown and gold geometric embroidered borders frame the neckline, center panel, waist and skirt hem. Reddish-brown layered sleeves and a broad matching embroidered wrap rest along her arms. A decorated sash has a round central metal fastening. Small gold drop earrings, a pendant, wrist cuff and ring provide restrained jewelry. Both pointed brown-gold shoes appear beneath the hem. The substantial layered cloth covers bust, abdomen, hips and pelvis.
